name: PowerDNS
description: Sends DNS zones to a PowerDNS Authoritative Server with its HTTP API. The panel keeps the records, and the plugin makes the zone in PowerDNS the same after each change.

credentials.label: API address
credentials.hint: The address of the API of PowerDNS, for example https://pdns.example.net:8081. Use HTTPS.

credentials.label: API key
credentials.hint: The value of api-key in the configuration of PowerDNS.

credentials.label: Name servers for new zones
credentials.hint: The NS records of a zone that the panel adds, with commas, for example ns1.example.net, ns2.example.net.
